question_text_raw: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] What exact order statuses qualify as “ready” for printing, and which statuses must block printing?
[NEEDS CLARIFICATION] When a packing slip is reprinted, should the system record an audit event, display a “reprint” marker, or limit who can reprint?
[NEEDS CLARIFICATION] If the printer is unavailable, should the system generate a downloadable/previewable slip, queue the print job, or fail with an error?
[NEEDS CLARIFICATION] Besides order identifier and item quantities, what item details must appear on the packing slip, such as SKU, item name, location/bin, or barcode?
